service_space_policy: External maintenance clearance; retained as editable transparent objects in exports, hidden from images by default.
identity_algorithm: SHA256 little-endian float64 mesh-local vertex xyz and uint32 polygon index order; separate float64 world matrix hash.
route_filter: Only common plus the selected route instantiated.
source_scope: Frozen evaluated C15 meshes retained without bevel, remesh, axis, material, or topology reconstruction. Candidate envelopes are visualization inputs, not verified hardware.
